NBA-BOS-at-DET-1020.summary: Season opener Tuesday. Derrick White left Boston's Oct. 14 preseason game after landing awkwardly, with no diagnosis given, which matters for Payton Pritchard's role. Detroit lost Tobias Harris and Isaiah Stewart and added Isaiah Joe as a shooter.

NBA-PHI-at-NY-1020.summary: Opening night at MSG (Tuesday 7 PM ET): LeBron James and Jaylen Brown debut for a Sixers team that also starts Embiid, Maxey and Edgecombe, so shots and assists will be split five ways in their first real game together. The Knicks open about -4.5 with a 230.5 total. Josh Hart (ankle) is expected to be available, and the Sixers' backup centers are thin (Hukporti out for the season, Bona still working back).

NFL-ARI-at-LA-1018.summary: Arizona is a 12.5-point road underdog without RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and safeties Andrew Wingard and Wydett Williams; Budda Baker is questionable. Tyler Allgeier moves into the lead-back role. The Rams have Kam Curl and Trent McDuffie questionable after both sat Friday. Arizona has allowed the most TDs in the league and 31+ points in four straight games, but the large spread brings blowout-script risk for Rams passing volume.

NFL-BAL-at-CLE-1018.summary: Lamar Jackson is ruled out after missing every practice, so Tyler Huntley makes his fourth fill-in start; Baltimore has won the last three, leaning on Derrick Henry (24 carries against Atlanta). Cleveland's interior run defense is thin: DT Mike Hall Jr. is out, and DT Mason Graham and LB Carson Schwesinger are questionable after missing two practices. RB Quinshon Judkins (questionable) went DNP, DNP, then limited Friday.

NFL-BUF-at-LV-1018.summary: Buffalo is a 5.5-point road favorite indoors with a 53.5 total. WR DJ Moore (shoulder) missed Week 5 and went DNP, DNP, then limited, so he is questionable; Joshua Palmer and DT Ed Oliver are also questionable. Las Vegas has one of the league's weakest run games and leans on Cousins' passing; its pass defense allows 236 yards a game (24th).

NFL-CHI-at-ATL-1018.summary: Caleb Williams practiced fully all week and is expected back from a three-game hamstring absence; Michael Penix Jr. starts through a rib injury with no designation. Chicago is without LBs T.J. Edwards and Keyshaun Elliott, edge Montez Sweat (suspended) and DL Dayo Odeyingbo, and RB Kyle Monangai is out, leaving D'Andre Swift as the clear lead back. Atlanta ranks second in rushing yards per game.

NFL-DAL-at-GB-1019.summary: Sunday Night Football at Lambeau (kickoff 8:20 PM ET Sunday Oct 18; the packet id's date is UTC). Green Bay's defensive front is badly thinned: Parsons, Hargrave (season over) and Ford are out, Riley is doubtful and Campbell questionable. Its receiver room lost Jayden Reed for the season and Skyy Moore for this game. Dallas is without CB Cobie Durant, LB Overshown and RT Drew Shelton; Javonte Williams is getting nearly every running-back opportunity but averaging under 4 yards per carry.

NFL-HOU-at-JAX-1018.summary: Houston plays in London without RB David Montgomery and S Jalen Pitre, so Woody Marks gets the backfield with only Dare Ogunbowale behind him. Marvin Harrison Jr. debuts for Houston days after a trade, but the opposing coach expects only a partial package; Tank Dell and Jayden Higgins are not available. Jacksonville (4-1) has the league's best run defense, is without LT Anton Harrison, CB Montaric Brown and its regular long snapper, and is a 2.5-point favorite.

NFL-LAC-at-KC-1018.summary: The winless Chargers come in with a battered offensive line (Joe Alt out, center Biadasz and RT Slater on IR) after Herbert was sacked five times last week, and a secondary missing Derwin James and Donte Jackson. Kansas City is without Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton, leaving Kelce, Worthy and young receivers, and previews expect a Walker-heavy game plan with KC favored by about a touchdown.

NFL-NO-at-NYG-1018.summary: The Saints are without linebackers Kaden Elliss and Anfernee Jennings. Chris Olave (illness: DNP, DNP, limited) and Alvin Kamara (back, limited all week) are questionable, and Tyler Shough has been under heavy pressure since his left tackle went down. The Giants start Jameis Winston for a fourth week; he threw 54 times in last week's overtime tie. Tight end Theo Johnson (neck) is out, so Isaiah Likely and the third receiver should see more snaps.

NFL-NYJ-at-NE-1018.summary: Breece Hall is out again, and Braelon Allen took 24 carries and 57 of 66 RB snaps last week as the lead back. New England activated A.J. Brown (high-ankle sprain) from IR Saturday but he is questionable after limited practices, and LT Will Campbell and RB TreVeyon Henderson were limited all week. The Jets' pass rush had eight sacks last week; Patriots are favored by 7 to 7.5.

NFL-PIT-at-TB-1018.summary: Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels makes his third straight start for Tampa Bay with Mayfield (thumb) out; Tampa's defense has been stingy against the pass and blitzes often, which pushes opponents into quick throws. Pittsburgh's receiver room is very thin (Pittman, Wilson, Skowronek out; Metcalf had an illness Friday but was cleared Saturday), Freiermuth was added Saturday with a calf issue, Rico Dowdle is back to full practice after three missed games, and starting safety DeShon Elliott is out.

NFL-TEN-at-IND-1018.summary: Two weak offenses: Tennessee (0-5) ranks 28th in red-zone TD rate and Cam Ward is averaging under 180 passing yards, while Indy's defense is 27th in yards per rush allowed. TE Tyler Warren was a late, Friday addition to the injury report (groin) and Indy's WR room is thin, with Alec Pierce on IR, Ashton Dulin out and Darius Slayton released. Tennessee's run defense (4th in yards per rush) is its strength.

NFL-WAS-at-SF-1020.summary: This is a Monday night game, so statuses can still change. Washington is without QB2 Mariota and RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt, leaving Rachaad White as lead back, and WR Stefon Diggs is questionable. San Francisco (5-0) is a 7.5-point favorite without Deebo Samuel, LB Dre Greenlaw (suspended) and Garret Wallow; Mike Evans (ribs) is questionable and Nick Bosa is listed out.

SOCCER-day.summary: Budimir is fit and predicted to lead the line for Osasuna with two attacking teammates out; Meerdink is predicted to start up top for AZ. Little current team news turned up for the other matches, so most players are neutral.

fix.summary: Quick checks on Top 10 and TD-list picks that had no note after the main research.

NFL-CAR-at-PHI-1018.summary: Carolina (2-2) comes off its bye with a passing game that has produced 1,268 yards in four games, while Philadelphia (2-3, three straight losses, 30th in offensive EPA/play) had both Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith (hamstrings) miss Wednesday's practice. Current books have this near a pick'em (PHI -1.5, total 42.5 at DraftKings, above the packet's 39.5). The prop story is Carolina's pass volume against a mediocre Eagles defense and a short-handed Hurts.

best.why: Breece Hall is ruled out for a third straight game, and last week Allen took 24 carries and played 86% of the offensive snaps while Isaiah Davis got two carries. The posted consensus matches the app's 16.5. The main risk is script: the Jets are about 7-point underdogs at New England.
